test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Heat Engine) Official Paper (Held On 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT the correct function of the front axle?

options.text: It transmits the torque of a vehicle through springs to the front wheels.
It absorbs torque applied on it due to braking of vehicle.
An axle is a central shaft for a rotating wheel or gear.
It supports the weight of the front part of the vehicle.

solution:
The correct answer is __Option 1__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Front axle__ is a crucial component of a vehicle's suspension and steering system.
 
• Its functions include absorbing torque applied due to braking, supporting the weight of the vehicle's front part, and serving as a central shaft for rotating wheels or gears.
 
• Option 1 is incorrect because the front axle does not transmit torque through springs to the front wheels. The transmission of torque is primarily handled by the drivetrain and associated components.
 
• Other functions, such as absorbing braking torque and bearing the vehicle's weight, are valid roles of the front axle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Front Axle Types:**

 
 
• Live axle: Transmits power from the engine to the wheels.
 
• Dead axle: Does not transmit power but supports the vehicle's weight.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Front Axle:**
 
 
• Ensures smooth steering and suspension performance.
 
• Contributes to overall vehicle stability and safety.
